description: React component for a booking form card with input validation and routing to a booking page.

methods.name: isValidName
methods.description: Validates that the name input is non-empty after trimming.

methods.name: isValidPhone
methods.description: Validates that the phone number matches a pattern allowing optional '+' and 10-15 digits.

methods.name: isValidPincode
methods.description: Validates that the pincode is a 5 or 6 digit number.
